description: This file defines the CheckToStringNode class, a Twig node used to enforce sandbox restrictions when casting expressions to __toString(). It ensures that such operations are permitted within the sandbox environment, primarily for security purposes in template rendering.

classes.name: CheckToStringNode
classes.description: A Twig node that checks whether casting an expression to __toString() is allowed under sandbox restrictions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the node with the expression to check.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to perform the sandbox check for __toString() conversion during template rendering.
